axis_method: One three-point quadratic subgrid maximum of laboratory mean_v per native y plane; unweighted straight-line least squares of x_c against y
reference_point: Fitted axis at the lowest accepted native y plane in the primary fit interval; analysis reference, not atomiser surface
resampling_policy: Rotate the native grid and all components directly; only line/section extraction uses four-finite-corner bilinear interpolation in the original rectangular grid, with no extrapolation
interpretation: Straight hydrodynamic-axis estimate, not independently verified mounting angle; curvature and asymmetry retained
